title: Git Fundamentals
tagline: Three areas, one command pattern -- every other Git command is a variation on moving files between them.

title: Branching & Merging
tagline: A branch is just a movable pointer to a commit -- that's the whole trick behind Git's speed.

title: Remote Repositories
tagline: GitHub doesn't do anything Git itself can't -- it's just a server hosting a copy of your repo.

title: History & Diffs
tagline: Every commit is a snapshot AND a diff -- Git stores the former, but almost always shows you the latter.

title: Undoing Changes
tagline: Git almost never deletes anything -- "undo" usually means "point somewhere else", which is why it's recoverable.

title: Rebasing & History
tagline: Merge preserves exactly what happened; rebase rewrites the story to look like it happened in a cleaner order.

title: Pull Requests
tagline: A pull request isn't a Git feature at all -- it's GitHub's UI wrapped around a branch and a diff you already understand.

title: GitHub Actions
tagline: A workflow file is just a YAML recipe for 'when X happens on GitHub, run these commands on a fresh machine.'

title: Advanced Git
tagline: The tools you reach for once a week, not once a day -- but genuinely painful to not know when you need them.
